verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents HTTP/Webhook triggers alongside app-event triggers for thousands of integrated apps. Its REST API covers managing event sources and subscriptions, and emitted events can be consumed over the REST API, a real-time SSE stream, or streamed to the CLI. A community post notes HTTP-trigger limits (100kb body, 10 req/s, 10s execution), which constrain heavy webhook use. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring webhook subscriptions and delivering events outbound to a user's own endpoint, plus independent hands-on corroboration of webhook subscription flows.
